title: Die Dominanzgesellschaft und der NSU-Komplex
summary: Which feelings and unconscious conflicts arise when dealing with the far right terrorism of the National Socialist Underground (NSU)? Taking a psychoanalytical approach, Charlie Kaufhold provides a multifaceted portrayal of German society, where racism and anti-semitism frequently influence people's perceptions. The focus are the psychosocial dynamics of the dominant society - that is, the part of society not affected by racism and/or anti-semitism.
